summary: Frontend-only regression for 8 UI/UX changes. All 8 features PASS end-to-end via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) against the public preview URL. Sign-in demo hint removed, inputs start empty. Show/hide password toggle flips input type password<->text (RN-Web removes type attr when secureTextEntry=false, then restores 'password' on toggle back). Remember-Me flow verified end-to-end: sam@teebox.demo/password123 sign-in with checkbox ON persists teebox_remember_me='1', teebox_remember_email, teebox_remember_password across sign-out, and both fields plus checkbox rehydrate on next visit; toggling OFF and re-signing removes all three keys and clears inputs. Feed header now shows 'header-my-profile' (person icon + 'My Profile' text) navigating to /profile; legacy 'header-log-round' testID is gone; notification bell still present. Top-of-feed spacing updated (HEADER_H + spacing.lg) visually matches inter-post gap. Discover defaults to Courses chip first with 'Search courses…' placeholder. Miles conversion works: 30 courses within 50 mi banner + distance pills read 'X.X mi away' (verified with San Diego geolocation seeded — Executive/Balboa/Championship etc. all show mi). Bottom-right tab reads 'More' with menu icon. Wrong-password sign-in shows 'Incorrect email or password'. No React Native red screens. Two non-blocking runtime warnings observed in console (informational only): 'shadow* style props are deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — from RN-Web layer, not from the 8 changes.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Not caused by the current changes but surfaces frequently on Sign-in/Feed/Discover; consider migrating to boxShadow in the shared shadow theme. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow.soft) used across TBButton, cards, header CTA.

React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Emitted on Feed load; likely from a third-party component (Ionicons/BlurView). Not from the 8 changes but worth flagging.

action_items: None required for the 8 requested changes — all verified passing.
(Optional) Migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' in /app/frontend/src/theme to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
(Optional) Track down the 'props.pointerEvents' warning source (likely BlurView or Ionicons wrapper) for a future cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: sign-in.tsx correctly waits for a successful signIn() before calling persistRemember(), so a bad password never writes credentials to storage.
Password persistence uses storage.secureSet (SecureStore on native, localStorage polyfill on web preview) — expected and acceptable per task note.
Feed header's 'My Profile' Pressable uses router.push('/(tabs)/profile'), matching the destination of the 'More' tab — parity confirmed.
Discover default tab initialization uses useState<Tab>('courses') and chip render order ['courses', 'golfers'] — both sources of truth aligned.
Distance formatting handles three ranges correctly: <0.1 mi -> feet, <10 mi -> 1 decimal, >=10 mi -> whole miles.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded demo account sam@teebox.demo / password123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 UI/UX changes for iteration verified. Playwright flow: fresh sign-in (verify empty inputs + no demo hint) -> toggle password eye -> sign-in with Remember ON -> observe Feed header-my-profile CTA + navigation -> Discover defaults to Courses -> seed geolocation (32.7157,-117.1611) -> verify 'mi away' pills + '50 mi' banner -> sign-out via profile-signout -> confirm rehydrate -> sign-in with Remember OFF -> sign-out -> confirm cleared. Bad password shows 'Incorrect email or password'. Storage keys: teebox_remember_me / teebox_remember_email / teebox_remember_password (localStorage on web).
